reviewNotes: Direct full paired review of all fish dialogue voices and game options. Runtime PondQueryMenu.UpdateState uses OneCount only for quantity <=1, and Lexicon performs neither articles nor plurals for a custom locale. Romanian therefore uses immutable item names followed by (×quantity), and OneCount is exactly 1. This preserves required quantities without ungrammatical plural/indefinite-article concatenation. Repeated placeholders and demanding/rude/formal/carnivore tones retained; complete strings avoid gender assumptions for item names. Glossary comparison corrected the inflected Remixate mode label and exact Recompensele Minei title.
